resources.string: Bodyweight squat
Plant both feet, with toes slightly outward.
Move hips back and down; keep knees tracking toes.
Keep heels down and return with control.
45° sled leg press
Support your back and place feet flat on the plate.
Press smoothly without locking the knees.
Lower with control; keep your hips on the seat.
Seated machine chest press
Adjust handles to mid-chest; support your back.
Press forward with straight wrists and relaxed shoulders.
Return slowly without letting the handles pull behind your chest.
Seated low cable row
Brace your feet and sit tall with soft knees.
Pull the handle toward your abdomen, elbows close.
Reach forward with control; keep your torso still.
Front lat pulldown
Secure thighs under the pad and plant your feet.
Bring elbows down as the bar approaches your upper chest.
Return slowly; keep the bar in front of your head.
Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
Stand tall with dumbbells close and knees slightly bent.
Push hips back, keeping a long, neutral spine.
Keep weights close; stand by bringing hips forward.
Seated machine shoulder press
Support your back; start with handles near shoulder height.
Press overhead with wrists aligned above elbows.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Bodyweight Bulgarian split squat
Rest the rear foot on a stable bench; plant the front foot.
Lower with control, keeping the front knee tracking your toes.
Press through the front foot; repeat on the other side.
Goblet squat
Hold one dumbbell close to the chest.
Keep heels planted as hips and knees bend.
Stand up without rounding the back.
Barbell back squat
Set the bar on the upper back, clear of the neck.
Brace and bend hips and knees with feet planted.
Rise with the bar balanced over the mid-foot.
Reverse lunge
Step one foot back from a stable stance.
Lower the rear knee toward the floor with the front heel down.
Push through the front foot to return; log reps per side.
Step-up
Place the whole lead foot on a stable low box.
Rise using the lead leg without springing off the trailing foot.
Step down with control; log reps per side.
Leg extension
Align the machine pivot with the knee.
Keep hips and back against the pads.
Extend and lower the knees smoothly without swinging.
Seated leg curl
Adjust the knee pivot and secure the thigh pad.
Start with legs extended without locking the knees.
Curl the heels under the seat and return slowly.
Standing calf raise
Stand with feet parallel and use light support for balance.
Lift both heels while keeping the knees softly straight.
Lower the heels with control.
Seated calf raise
Sit with forefeet on the platform and thigh pads secure.
Raise the heels while keeping knees bent.
Lower smoothly through a comfortable range.
Barbell hip thrust
Support the upper back on a stable bench and pad the bar.
Keep feet planted and lift the hips until trunk and thighs align.
Lower without overextending the lower back.
Glute bridge
Lie on the back with knees bent and feet planted.
Lift the hips while keeping the ribs down.
Lower slowly without pushing through the neck.
Barbell Romanian deadlift
Hold the bar close to the thighs with knees slightly bent.
Send the hips back while the bar travels close to the legs.
Stand by extending the hips without leaning back.
Dumbbell bench press
Lie on a stable flat bench with feet planted.
Lower the dumbbells beside the chest with forearms upright.
Press upward without bouncing or striking the dumbbells.
Incline dumbbell press
Set a moderate incline and keep back and feet supported.
Lower the dumbbells beside the upper chest.
Press up with wrists stacked over elbows.
Push-up
Place hands under or slightly wider than the shoulders.
Keep shoulders, hips and heels in one line as the chest lowers.
Push back up without letting the hips sag.
Knee push-up
Rest knees on a mat and set hands near shoulder width.
Keep shoulders, hips and knees aligned while lowering.
Press back up without bending at the waist.
Cable chest fly
Stand balanced between pulleys with a slight elbow bend.
Bring the handles together in front of the chest.
Return slowly without letting the shoulders roll forward.
Single-arm dumbbell row
Support one hand and knee on a stable bench.
Pull the dumbbell toward the hip without twisting the torso.
Lower under control; log reps and dumbbell load per side.
Chest-supported dumbbell row
Rest the chest against an inclined bench with feet stable.
Pull the dumbbells toward the lower ribs.
Lower smoothly while keeping the chest supported.
Pull-up
Use an overhand grip and hang with controlled shoulders.
Pull the chest toward the bar without swinging.
Lower steadily; log external added load only.
Cable face pull
Set a rope pulley around face height and stand balanced.
Pull the rope toward the face while separating the hands.
Return with control without shrugging the shoulders.
Dumbbell shoulder press
Sit with the back supported and feet planted.
Start with dumbbells near the shoulders and wrists over elbows.
Press overhead without arching the lower back.
Dumbbell lateral raise
Stand tall with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the arms out to the sides to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging or shrugging.
Bent-over rear delt fly
Hinge at the hips with a neutral back and softly bent knees.
Open the arms to the sides with a slight elbow bend.
Lower the dumbbells without moving the torso.
Dumbbell shrug
Hold dumbbells at the sides with arms straight.
Lift the shoulders toward the ears without rolling them.
Lower smoothly while keeping the neck neutral.
Dumbbell curl
Stand tall with palms facing forward and elbows near the sides.
Bend the elbows without swinging the upper arms.
Lower slowly; log the load of one dumbbell.
Hammer curl
Hold the dumbbells with palms facing inward.
Curl while keeping elbows near the sides and wrists neutral.
Lower with control; log the load of one dumbbell.
Machine preacher curl
Adjust the seat so upper arms rest fully on the pad.
Curl the handles without lifting the arms off the support.
Return slowly without locking the elbows.
Cable triceps pushdown
Use a high pulley and keep elbows near the sides.
Straighten the elbows without leaning body weight onto the handle.
Return slowly while upper arms stay still.
Overhead dumbbell extension
Sit supported and hold one dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Bend the elbows to lower the weight behind the head.
Extend the elbows without arching the back.
Dead bug
Lie on the back with hips and knees bent and arms up.
Extend the opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back stable.
Return and switch sides; log reps per side.
Reverse crunch
Lie on the back with bent knees and arms resting at the sides.
Curl the pelvis toward the ribs with a small controlled lift.
Lower slowly without swinging the legs.
Kneeling cable crunch
Kneel facing a high pulley with the rope held beside the head.
Curl the ribs toward the pelvis rather than pulling with the arms.
Return with control while keeping hips relatively still.
